qa_pair.question: In the evaluation capture, inspect successful authentication exchanges. Which raw response header names the identity behind the newest successful session? Return its value only.
Compare the saved cart POST attempts and inspect the failed attempt's body. What error code explains the rejected cart? Return the code only.
Find the export exchange, read its response, and decode the Base64 job label it contains. What label is it?
Compare the newest saved catalog request with the oldest catalog request. Which X-Revision value was introduced in the newer request?
Search the evaluation's failed exchanges, inspect their metadata and raw messages, and identify the HTTP method used by the TLS failure.
Use target summaries and history pages to identify which origin has the largest captured request count. Return the origin only.
Inspect both successful cart creations. Which SKU appears in the request body for the later successful creation?
Find the cart attempt that returned 409 and compare its body to successful attempts. How many cart POST captures in total used that same SKU? Return the integer.
Find and read the long export response across bounded pages. What X-Export-Checksum value appears after its padding?
Inspect the latest catalog response and URL-decode its encoded next-page link. Return the decoded relative path.
